candidate_program.name: residual_mean_contrast
candidate_program.rationale: Adjusts count efficiency by a bounded comparison between mean preserved weight and mean blocker weight, keeping counts and weights separately normalized. Reach includes coarse residual totals; repeated scalar arithmetic and aggregate maintenance cost time, and preserved contacts may conflict with each other.
candidate_program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) * (1 + 0.15 * (compatible_weight / max(1, remaining_count - degree - 1) - conflict_weight / max(1, degree)) / (1 + compatible_weight / max(1, remaining_count - degree - 1) + conflict_weight / max(1, degree)))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
